name: PPI k=1 matched ten-seed method comparison
schedule: Instances in listed order; for each new seed, Greedy followed by VNS
controls: Reuse original published Greedy/VNS binaries; no compilation or changes to their algorithms
Match seeds and parameters to archived Hybrid runs, not the injected-initial-state ablation
Use separate output folder and replay all 90 complete label vectors
Greedy has no internal wall-time deadline; record actual construction time
VNS uses original 3600-second ceiling and original iteration/stagnation stops; no shortening
Archived Hybrid ILP thread count was not pinned; runtime comparisons remain descriptive
analysis: Per-instance paired objectives, W-T-L, relative improvements, runtime, and seed-13579-excluded sensitivity; no claim of independent biological replications
estimate_note: About 19.1 hours serial from gate timings; allow 18-24 hours, conservatively about 30 hours
